item.tib: bder gshegs dgongs pa kun 'dus 'chi med gsang ba sum dril gyi srung ba mi shig btsan rdzong
item.coloph: ces bder gshegs dgongs pa 'dus pa 'chi med gsang ba sum dril gyi srung ba'i cha lag mi shig btsan rdzong 'di nyid grogs kyis bskul zhing nye bar sgrab pa chen po'i cha rkyen du rgyal khams phyogs kun 'khyams pa'i kho bo rat+na gling gis dngos po zhes pa 'byung ba lnga ldan shing pho khyi lo'i yar tshes bzang por bgyis pa 'dis kyang gsang chen bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
